definitions.intensity: Executed floating-point operations / measured DRAM read+write bytes, separately by precision; fused multiply-add counts twice, packed-half convention must be validated.
definitions.throughput: The same executed operation count / the corresponding replay kernel duration.
definitions.ceilings: Nsight architectural peak work/cycle times observed SM clock and peak DRAMbytes/cycle times observed memory clock; modeled clock-adjusted hardware ceilings, not empirically measured sustained calibration.
definitions.roofline_region: Position relative to a precision-compatible ridge; not proof of the actual limiting resource.
definitions.observed_bottleneck: Requires compatible measured utilization evidence. Far-below-roofline, mixed/tensor ambiguity, missing counters or uncertain ROI remain unknown.
definitions.aggregation: Never average intensities or equally weight distinct kernels. Whole-region positions require complete stage mapping, multiplicities, compatible work/bytes/time and concurrency treatment.

coverage_rules: All537 names and four models receive explicit evidence/status records. Five unchanged native hardware barriers have no fake points.
Integer, atomic, launch-only, memory-only and host/communication work are not forced onto a scalar floating-point roofline.
First-per-kernel or first-per-launch-shape samples are kernel observations, not complete-ROI evidence; warmup/setup/validation and unassigned stages remain labeled.
Collect raw counters separately from accepted unprofiled five-trial means. Profile times never replace primary timings or correctness outcomes.
Preserve original inferred ontology labels; add model/configuration/device-specific measured fields and source/capture/profile hashes.
OneGPU6 profiler at a time under shared lock and external-process idle guards. No sudo, escalation workaround, global clock changes or OS changes.
Fresh scratch outputs only; no historical run, binary artifact or fixed capture root may be overwritten. Bounded output storage and explicit special-case review required.
Profiler/annotation effort is shared measurement work, separate from earlier translation cost; missing actual costs stay unknown.
initialization_only: No benchmark resource classification is established by inventory creation.
